item.title: Ukraine uses russia's own Air Defence... ...to shoot down an advanced russian jet fighter!
item.description:
Ukrainian hackers and intelligence experts intercepted control parameters and altered operational data for the 'BARS Moscow' air defense system. They then exploited severe software vulnerabilities to trick the Russian air defense crew - deployed to protect Moscow - into misidentifying their own high-tech fighter as a hostile threat, triggering the fatal launch. This unprecedented operation resulted in the complete destruction of a russian Su-57 stealth fighter jet valued at over $100 million. While the Russian Ministry of Defense publicly attributed the crash to a 'technical failure', Russian military channels and pro-war media quickly confirmed that the jet fell victim to friendly fire.
Further information on this incident, along with translations

item.title: GovBrief Today #539
item.description: Two men looked at your electric bill today, and only one put money on the table. Rhode Island Energy announced a 15% winter rate hike this morning. Within hours, Gov. Dan McKee declared an energy affordability emergency and moved $28 million in carbon fees paid by power plants so the average family won't pay a dollar more this winter. By afternoon, Donald Trump was at the EPA collecting signatures on a voluntary pledge and promising that despite the data center boom, "electricity bills for American families will actually come down." Analysts expect those data centers to push bills up as much as 40% in the next four years, and a pledge doesn't bind a single utility. In Rhode Island, nobody has to apply for the relief. item.title: Now we can't even post YouTube links in comments due to scammers
item.description: Do not click "onlinevideos.click". It's a nasty linkfarm that seems to appear now whenever someone posts a YouTube video in the comments on a post that recently hit FP. It seems to be a script wrapping a YouTube downloader into an absolutely ad infested page. Then the bot posts its link and has a swarm to upvote itself over the original comment (and DOWNVOTE whoever actually made them comment!). If you see one of these, DO NOT CLICK it. Report it, and, go upvote the hapless person being brigade downvoted to hide their comment/link! I've found 4 of these exact sequence today.

Been a while since I lost posted. Funny how time seems to slip by. All is well, though we did lost a few more chickens. Still sucks but the life of owning chickens. They also love eating all my uncrustables. ;-;) Jasmne was having fun pushing the dice during the session. She enjoys sitting next to me and getting head scratches. On a more personal note, I am one month no alcohol! Feels good. Before Baby Dragon, I didn't really drink but afterwards, things started to slip. Badly. A road I really did not want to go down. It is a bit embarrassing to admit but hopefully someone else can understand. The temptation is still there but it is getting quieter.
Also, can someone tell Baby Dragon to stop growing up so fast. ;-;
